title: Crispy Picarones with Fish and Garlic Aioli
description: A twist on traditional Peruvian donuts, these crispy picarones are filled with a flavorful fish and garlic aioli. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Fish (such as tilapia or cod), cooked and flaked

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the picarones flour, cornmeal, and salt.
Add the garlic, Peruvian yellow pepper, and fish to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the buttermilk and egg.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop the dough into the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the fried picarones on paper towels.
To make the garlic aioli, mix together the garlic, mayonnaise, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Serve the crispy picarones with a side of garlic aioli for dipping.
